# AI Coding Video

> A 270-style library and Agent Skill (SKILL.md) for making videos deterministically by code from time t: 211 pure-code styles (browser Canvas/WebGL/Three.js/SVG/Hydra/Motion/HyperFrames + headless Python NumPy/Pillow/Skia/MoviePy/Blender/Manim), 28 real-footage styles (including depth-sandwiched text, object tracking, 3D document highlighters, SRTM terrain and 3DGS AR), 31 AI-material styles, and a C-lead hybrid media-slot workflow (`media_slots.js` + 211 media-fit screening). Documentation is in Chinese; this page is bilingual.

- Repository: https://github.com/chans-gh/AI-Coding-Video
- Install for Claude Code: `claude plugin marketplace add chans-gh/AI-Coding-Video` then `claude plugin install ai-coding-video@ai-coding-video`
- License: MIT

## Docs

- [README](https://github.com/chans-gh/AI-Coding-Video/blob/main/README.md): what it is, install for Claude Code, Codex, DeepSeek Harness, WorkBuddy
- [SKILL.md](https://github.com/chans-gh/AI-Coding-Video/blob/main/skills/ai-coding-video/SKILL.md): instructions the agent follows; two tracks: style demos / lightweight packs or full-film production (with L1 media slots & L2 guest shots)
- [Style index](https://github.com/chans-gh/AI-Coding-Video/blob/main/skills/ai-coding-video/index.md): all 270 styles by topic, content type, purpose, mood, platform and 211 C-class media-fit screening
- [Making samples](https://github.com/chans-gh/AI-Coding-Video/blob/main/skills/ai-coding-video/making.md): render pipeline, `new_pack.py` scaffolding (`--media` / `--add-media` / `--save` to `~/aicv-my-styles/`), and `media_slots.js` topology
- [Full film](https://github.com/chans-gh/AI-Coding-Video/blob/main/skills/ai-coding-video/film.md): six steps of a full film, L1/L2 hybrid storyboards, Format-5 handoff (`storyboard.md`), placeholder-first rendering and automated QA
- [Materials](https://github.com/chans-gh/AI-Coding-Video/blob/main/skills/ai-coding-video/materials.md): classes C, T, G, 5-family visual fusion formulas and companion style prompts

## Examples

- [Samples](https://github.com/chans-gh/AI-Coding-Video/tree/main/samples): reproducible render code for all 270 styles (16:9 and 9:16), plus `new_pack.py`
- [Style packs](https://github.com/chans-gh/AI-Coding-Video/blob/main/packs/README.md): reusable, re-brandable code modules (`dark-keynote` pure-code + `media_slots.js` hybrid demos, `news-brief`, `style-swap`)
- [Case studies](https://github.com/chans-gh/AI-Coding-Video/blob/main/cases/README.md): complete ~5-minute videos with storyboard, code, time and cost
